about.heading: About Tour-Trip
about.intro: Connecting curious travelers with authentic Cambodian culture, hidden jungle sanctuaries, and the timeless majesty of the Khmer Kingdom.
about.rootsTitle: Born in Cambodia, Crafted for Thoughtful Explorers
about.rootsText1: Tour-Trip was founded by native Cambodian cultural archivists and veteran guides who noticed mass tourism was bypassing the real heartbeat of the Kingdom. Beyond the standard tour buses, Cambodia holds untamed cardamom mountains, living village economies, and sacred temple insights waiting for meaningful discovery.
about.rootsText2: Every itinerary we curate is designed around local knowledge, cultural respect, and genuine human connection—so travelers can experience Cambodia with curiosity, confidence, and care.
about.stat1Desc: Direct revenues empower local village economies.
about.stat2Desc: Donated to temple masonry & clean water wells.
about.principlesIntro: Every journey with us balances effortless digital convenience with profound cultural immersion and safety.

principles.title: Authentic Discovery
principles.description: We venture beyond crowded selfie stops into private sunrise access, hidden jungle shrines, and sacred mountain trails.
principles.label: Rare experiences

principles.title: Certified Local Guides
principles.description: Licensed Khmer historians and passionate storytellers who grew up in the shadow of Angkor and bring cultural depth to every route.
principles.label: Officially certified

principles.title: Seamless & Safe
principles.description: Transparent pricing, flexible bookings, well-planned transportation, and clear communication from reservation to return.
principles.label: Travel with confidence

principles.title: Sustainable Impact
principles.description: We support local families, community tourism, and conservation-led experiences that keep Cambodia vibrant for future generations.
principles.label: Community first
